constructionManager.name: Bilal Barah
constructionManager.description: The Construction Manager shall report to Site Manager, developing and arranging the site construction team to the site necessary to manage and supervise the construction work including HSE and quality control, overall implementation and monitoring of all the activities for the successful completion of construction works

purpose: This risk assessment gives guidelines contained herein to ensure that the job execution complies with the requirement of the specification and the authorities concerned and serves the intended purpose to satisfactory level.
scope: Covers the nature and sequence of activities for interior renovation and construction works as itemized in the risk register below.

items.activity: 1. Preparing the site: covering doors, door frames, furniture (if any), floor protection, etc.
items.mitigation: Standard site prep and floor protection procedures.

items.riskDescription: Labor hazard; potential damage to structural/surrounding areas
items.impact: Potential project delay if major damage occurs
items.mitigation: Labor must strictly comply with HSE standards. Workers will receive site induction and briefings prior to demolition.

items.activity: 3. Covering corridor elevator and common areas for material transport
items.mitigation: Protective sheets applied to common areas and elevator interiors.

items.activity: 4. Debris dumping, site cleaning, and ongoing site preparation
items.mitigation: Labor will wear full PPE and follow standard waste management and site housekeeping guidelines.

items.activity: 5. MEP pre-installation prep (toilets, washbasins, showers, piping)
items.riskDescription: Site hazard; risk of damaging main shaft or main waterproofing membrane
items.impact: Work halt until site issue is fully resolved
items.mitigation: Construction Manager will directly supervise piping and drainage layout. No relocation of drainage that risks touching main slab or structural wall.

items.activity: 6. Wall plastering; applying polymer cement-based waterproof paint to walls and floors
items.mitigation: Apply according to manufacturer technical datasheets and specs.
Construction Manager will inspect MEP preparation and ensure waterproofing application is 100% compliant before flood test.
Construction Manager will supervise pressure testing and verify all mechanical connections.

items.activity: 9. Tile installation using Mapei waterproofing adhesive (off-site slab cutting in factory with necessary field trimming)
items.riskDescription: paint scratches or minor surface damage during handling
items.impact: Minor delay in case of material damage or labor injury
items.mitigation: Labor must strictly comply with safety standards (eye/ear PPE) and handle high-value tile slabs carefully.

items.activity: 10. Moisture-resistant (MR) gypsum board ceiling installation for kitchen & bathrooms
items.mitigation: Standard framing and ceiling installation techniques.

items.riskDescription: Paint scratches or minor surface damage during handling
items.mitigation: All materials wrapped in protective film at factory and handled with care during transport and assembly.

items.activity: 12. Painting works using pneumatic sprayers and Mapei tile grouting
items.mitigation: Ensure proper ventilation during pneumatic spray application.
Joint walk-through with client to finalize punch list items.
